messages:
Jordan (PM): Quick thread 102: We need a compact "safeguard" checklist for catalog entries that ties onboarding gates to migration runway and comms. Goal: reduce back-and-forth with legal/AE while keeping safety rails.

Priya (Eng): Propose required metadata fields on submission: compat_label, estimated_token_cost, preferred_variant (quant/full), sample_manifest link. Those let the infra choose kernels and routing policy.

Marco (SRE): Rollout constraints: default canary = 2 tenants x 7 days for mid-tier models, 2 tenants x 14 days for high-impact. Must include auto-fallback route and an SLO budget threshold trigger (e.g., if error budget >70% consumed in 6h rollback).

Evelyn (Prod): From PM/customer side: default pin 90 days, but allow 45d for fast-adopt if vendor signs migration assistance. Need clear migration playbook steps for customers (data export, embedding migration, version mapping).

Liam (CS): Support asks: include a short cutover checklist we can send customers: expected downtime (usually none), migration testing window, contact matrix (AE/SE/Eng) and post-cutover validation checklist.

ingest-bot: Ticket created: #7128 "catalog-safeguards" https://redwood/tickets/7128

Priya (Eng): Benchmarks: require JSON payload with fields: samples, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, avg_tokens_per_call, failure_rate. Example snippet: {"samples":1000,"p95_ms":220,"p99_ms":480,"failure_rate":0.002}. For embeddings add cosine-stability metric.

Jordan (PM): Acceptance criteria draft: 1) perf: p99 < 600ms on standard host profile OR documented justification; 2) quality: failure_rate <0.5% and embedding drift <0.03; 3) ops: canary + auto-fallback + runbook; 4) comms: migration playbook + customer template; 5) metadata: compat_label present.

Evelyn (Prod): Prioritization rule: models flagged as "enterprise-contract" or top-5% traffic automatically go to "High" lane. Others to "Standard". We should publish a short SLA blurb for each lane.

Marco (SRE): Monitoring: token-cost delta alert (>25% vs baseline) during canary and trace spans to tie regressions to quant/kernel. Also require 14d metric retention for full-entry canaries.

Jordan (PM): I'll turn this into ACs on #7128 and assign owners: Priya -> bench schema + ingest; Marco -> alerts/runbook; Evelyn -> migration playbook; Liam -> customer checklist. Quick sync Friday 11:00. :calendar: Jordan out.
